name: Z.AI Co. Ltd.
summary: Z.AI Co. Ltd. (Z.AI), formerly Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology Co., Ltd., was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Beijing. Through its subsidiaries it provides large model services in China, either deployed on customers' own infrastructure or delivered through the cloud by subscription or usage. Its offerings include z.ai, AutoGLM, ChatGLM and AMiner, and it serves enterprises, public bodies, researchers and individual developers.
